topic: Direction Light Control and Fault Monitoring
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific service interface related to direction light control or fault status subscription.
column_semantics: Columns represent different system components or control methods (e.g., SOA, LHZCU, ICB, RHZCU) and the type of control (e.g., hardline control).

core_entities.name: DirectionLightErrSts
core_entities.description: Interface for subscribing to direction light fault status.

core_entities.name: ControlDirectionLight
core_entities.description: Interfaces for controlling direction lights (left and right front).

core_conditions.name: DirectionLightErrSts
core_conditions.description: Indicates the fault status of direction lights. Values: 0x0 (No Error), 0x1 (Error).

core_conditions.name: DirectionLightReq
core_conditions.description: Request parameter for controlling direction lights. Values: 0x0 (OFF), 0x1 (ON).

core_outputs.name: LeftFrontDirectionLight
core_outputs.description: Controls the left front direction light (turn signal).

core_outputs.name: RightFrontDirectionLight
core_outputs.description: Controls the right front direction light (turn signal).

core_faults.name: DirectionLightFault
core_faults.description: Represents a fault condition in the direction light system.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the service interfaces for monitoring direction light faults and controlling the left and right front direction lights, enabling tests to verify fault detection and light control functionality.
